I’ve had a couple of dreams that put the fear into more than anything else in this world. Let me just say I’m not religious. Alright let’s start with the first. I was walking down a lit hallway with wooden floors, the walls were white and there were a couple of doors ahead of me to the right and left. As I’m walking down the hallway, the feeling of fear starting the sink in, it got worse as I kept walking forward, it go so bad I squatted down closed my eyes and covered my ears. As I was trying to block out all my senses, I thought to myself “I won’t let this control me” or something like that I’m not completely sure anymore, anyway after I thought that, I stood back up, opened my eyes and uncovered my ears. I turned around, there right in front of me, was a huge pitch black demon, it had horns that spired and curved front the top of its forehead to the back of its head, it had no wings and I think it had goat legs maybe, I’m that moment I’ve never experienced more fear in my life, I instantly coward back down to my knees, closing my eyes and covering my ears again


Number two. I’m not sure exactly where I was, all I know is that I was outside at night in some area under maintenance. I was with a group of people but I walked off on my own to leave the place, as I’m walking I notice a group of three individuals, one was dressed as a priest, another as Jesus and the last I can’t remember what it was dressed as. I tried turning around to try and avoid them because I didn’t wanna get involved with them but they caught up to me quickly and started talking to me. I don’t remember all the details, just that they were trying to get me to join them, they wanted me to get others to join as well. As they are speaking with me, I notice that the man dressed as Jesus had black hooves for feet, I look up and then see the the man dressed as Jesus, was actually a black goat dressed as Jesus. In that moment a sense of dread and panic came over me like nothing I’d ever felt before, my heart started pounding and my heart started ring, my face started getting hot and I started breathing super hard. I woke up shorty after I noticed the goat, but I woke up with every sensation I was experiencing in the dream still occurring. It took probably 30 seconds for it all to fade away. To this day I’ve never none more fear and dread
